external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: The text also describes franchise colleagues as a separate population.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: own device
external_entities.description: A colleague's own device used to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: franchise store
external_entities.description: A franchise store whose colleagues are allowed to sign in through the broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by a franchise store that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which group membership and leaver changes are pulled overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, consumes HR changes, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The broker uses a signing key kept in the key store.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used to sign tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us
data_flows.notes: The source does not explicitly describe the franchise colleague's initiating interaction separately from the identity-provider assertion.

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.data_description: Assertion about a franchise colleague's identity

data_flows.name: change prices and void transactions
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the store admin console to change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions
data_flows.notes: A store-manager token works against every store.
data_flows.data_description: Store price changes and transaction voids

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the broker's public signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The broker reads the signing key from the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The broker maintains the directory of colleagues and group memberships.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The broker pulls group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The same overnight process is how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: It is unknown whether the log covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: The environment containing colleagues' own devices used from home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment containing franchise colleagues and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds a token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds the broker's signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleague identities and group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's contents are confidential because it records sign-ins associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
